heading: Service connects us.
subheading: Combat Veterans Motorcycle Association® Kentucky Chapter 1-4
banner_alt: Official Auxiliary, Full Member, and Supporter logos over an American flag, with Vets Helping Vets lettering
body:
This chapter website concept centers on camaraderie, community activities, and connection through motorcycling.

Chapter history, approved mission copy, membership guidance, and local service partners will be added after officer review.
card_body: The Chapter 1-4 ODL presentation removes the white canvas and uses a red registered mark for contrast. The original supplied artwork is retained separately for comparison. Naming follows Brand Manual Revision B.
card_note: Public launch requires the appropriate chapter review and State Representative approval. This demo does not claim approval.
